observed.fact: --target value is aarch64-macos only; no CPU feature option. Source and compile-kir allocate a fresh M. Need explicit per-compilation settings on both routes and project route, not global mutable compiler constant.

No named target-feature/header flag. Header has documented counters/stats and240..255 scratch; unused-looking words are not a negotiated contract. Add named compiler-only field through MEMORY-MAP/gen-ns/unit contract or explicit options parameter; do not repurpose statistics/scratch or x7 fields.

KSEED1 contains only code length,exports,raw bytes; KSEEDO1 has namespace/import/export/pool/code records. Neither carries CPU requirement. Feature requirements must survive object linking as union; old readers must reject feature-bearing new version, never strip it.

Native profile and provenance are fixed strings. Sealed profile can be extended canonically, but source-route program/kir-sha256 are nil and normal stage0 run/extract refuse them. Sidecar alone cannot enforce executable admission.

Loader accepts raw bytes+offset+arity+isa, or compile-time embedded bytes/isa. It does not parse KSEED/EDN profiles, bind a feature manifest, or check CPU features before RX. SIGILL trapping is after execution and is insufficient.
Context_v11 has no feature bitmap/reserved negotiated flags; version, fuel, allow mask are not CPU flags. No struct extension needed for supervisor-only execution admission.

Cache identity already accepts emit-metadata; feature recipe must join that material. Recorded emitter route supports verifier re-emission only once feature settings are bound to emitter options; existing recorded seed hash alone does not express per-job CRC selection.

proposed_minimal_path: CLI accepts --target-feature crc32 only with aarch64-macos, absent means empty feature set/default software. Reject unknown/duplicate conflicting feature spellings. Propagate normalized options to all source/KIR/project paths; cr-feature compile-time1 becomes per-compilation explicit option0/1 with bounded rule and current guards unchanged.

Canonical build recipe includes target, sorted permitted features, actual required features, optimizer/source/emitter pins. Recipe CID is separate from semantic DefCID. Required crc32 recorded whenever hardware words emitted; permitted-but-unused feature may be retained in recipe only. Cache/re-emission use the same normalized recipe.

First safely limited adoption route can package immutable code with compile-time KEXE_EMBEDDED_REQUIRED_FEATURES and digest-bound recipe. Loader gate before RX/fork/guest entry checks known requirements and actual host support; unsupported ISA/unknown features/missing detection fail closed. Empty mask executes software unchanged. This route needs no new capability wire or context_v11 layout change.

For standalone files, new versioned feature-bearing container/envelope with exact code digest and requirements is necessary; parsing must happen in loader or trusted verifier before raw extraction. Current raw loader cannot promise fail-closed by sidecar/env assertion. Feature-bearing files must not be accepted by old readers; raw native escape remains explicitly unmanaged unless instruction verification/allowlist also enforces requirements.

KSEEDO feature-bearing version and linker union are required before feature-enabled multi-module/selfhost artifacts are supported. In the minimal first route reject such jobs until union/provenance/loader contracts exist; never silently lose requirements.

Host detection remains supervisor-local. macOS actual sysctl result for FEAT_CRC32/armv8_crc32 may support gate, with absent/error/unsupported platform refusal. No hostname/CPU-name inference. Future Linux needs a verified HWCAP contract; do not implement guessed constants. No automatic optimization based on build host.
